questions.stem: A 10-year-old boy is brought to the hospital with symptoms of an inguinal hernia. During the operation, the surgeon observes a segment of necrotic bowel in the hernial sac. What is the appropriate course of action for resection and anastomosis of a necrotic bowel seen during surgery? (NEET PG 2018)

options.label: A
options.text: The surgeon must use chromic catgut.

options.label: B
options.text: The surgeon must not include the submucosa in the sutures.

options.label: C
options.text: The surgeon must use the single layer, extramucosal suture technique.

options.label: D
options.text: The surgeon must use the single- layer seromuscular suture technique.
